newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BRAU UNION HUNGARY UNIT SEES H1 PROFIT UP.
newsitem.headline: BRAU UNION HUNGARY UNIT SEES H1 PROFIT UP.

text.p: The Hungarian unit of Austria's Brau Union AG expects higher profits for the first half of 1997 compared to the same period of 1996, Brau Union Hungaria's Deputy CEO Attila Laszlo said on Thursday.
"In the first half of 1997 the result will be substantially above the one in the same period of 1996," Laszlo told a news conference.
Brau Union Hungaria said in a statement that it had sales revenue of around 10 billion forints in the first six months of 1997.
"The company's management estimates that this turnover would justify expectations of 20 billion forints turnover by the end of the year," it said in a statement.
Brau Union has more than 22 percent of the Hungarian beer market.
Brau Union Hungaria owns Soproni and Martfui breweries which were merged on May 1.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Soproni shares closed at 6,100 forints on Wednesday.
